name: POI Component Type 5 Code
definition: Type of component belonging to a POI (Point of Interaction) Terminal.

AQPP.name: Acquirer Protocol Parameters
AQPP.definition: Parameters for acquirer interface of the point of interaction, including acquirer host configuration parameters.

APPR.name: Application Parameters
APPR.definition: Parameters of a payment application running on the point of interaction.

TLPR.name: Terminal Parameters
TLPR.definition: Manufacturer configuration parameters of the point of interaction.

SCPR.name: Security Parameters
SCPR.definition: Security parameters of the point of interaction.

SERV.name: Server
SERV.definition: Payment server of a point of interaction system.

DVCE.name: Device
DVCE.definition: Device sub-component of a component of the point of interaction.

EMVK.name: EMV Kernel
EMVK.definition: EMV application kernel (EMV is the chip card specifications initially defined by Eurocard, Mastercard and Visa).

EMVO.name: EMV Level 1
EMVO.definition: EMV physical interface (EMV is the chip card specifications initially defined by Eurocard, Mastercard and Visa).

MDWR.name: Middleware
MDWR.definition: Software module of the point of interaction.

DRVR.name: Driver
DRVR.definition: Driver module of the point of interaction.

OPST.name: Operating System
OPST.definition: Software that manages hardware to provide common services to the applications.

MRPR.name: Merchant Parameters
MRPR.definition: Merchant configuration parameters for the point of interaction (POI).

CRTF.name: Certificate Parameters
CRTF.definition: Certificate provided by a terminal manager.

TMSP.name: TMS Protocol Parameters
TMSP.definition: Configuration parameters for the TMS protocol.

SAPR.name: Sale To POI Protocol Parameters
SAPR.definition: Parameters related to the Sale to POI protocol.
